svg.title: Attribute the failure before you fix anything
svg.desc: A hand-drawn diagnostic flowchart starting from 'the answer was WRONG' and branching first on whether the gold chunk reached the context window - 68 of 100 failures were retrieval - and then on whether it sat in the top five positions, splitting the rest into a position effect and 24 of 100 generation failures, with 8 both. To the right, a U-shaped curve plots answer accuracy 0.84, 0.71, 0.63, 0.68, 0.78 against the gold chunk's position in a twenty-chunk context with the dip at position ten ringed and labelled lost in the middle, and a bar chart shows accuracy peaking at k=10 with 0.81 and falling to 0.68 at k=50.
svg.text: Attribute the failure before you fix anything
was the gold chunk in the context
was it in the top 5 positions?
accuracy vs the gold chunk's position
accuracy vs how many chunks you retrieve
worse past k=10 - and 5x the tokens
no eval set = no deltas = no engineering. 100 queries, 2
...every week-28 trick is a row in this
